name: papilot
description: A Cursor-like workspace for your papers: annotate and review PDFs directly without ever touching LaTeX.
author: Cui Chen

scripts.setup:review: npm --prefix engine ci && npm --prefix engine run build
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node scripts/check-ui.mjs && node scripts/check-task-model.mjs && node scripts/check-appearance.mjs && node scripts/check-updates.mjs && node scripts/check-papers.mjs && node scripts/check-imports.mjs && node scripts/check-compilation.mjs && node scripts/check-build-problems.mjs && node scripts/check-review-notes.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-note-groups.mjs && node scripts/check-note-selection.mjs && node scripts/check-ai-review.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-note-results.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-review-flow.mjs && node scripts/check-skills.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-skill-library.mjs && node scripts/check-attachments.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-accounts.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-places.mjs && node scripts/check-pdf-words.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run setup:review
scripts.desktop: npm run setup:review && npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && node scripts/desktop.mjs dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run setup:review && npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && node scripts/desktop.mjs package
scripts.test:locales: npm run build && npm --prefix engine run build && node --import tsx scripts/check-locales.mjs
